en.summary: The American billionaire reached an oil agreement with Putin, reverting to pro-Kremlin positions and advising Ukraine to change its president.

stories.title: Après l'attaque de Riyad, le trafic aérien saoudien paralysé et les compagnies sous pression

en.title: After the Riyadh attack, Saudi Arabian air traffic paralyzed and airlines under pressure
en.summary: Riyadh's international airport remained closed following an attack that killed twelve people and injured over 300. Multiple international airlines suspended flights to the Saudi capital, with disruptions spreading to other airports in the kingdom.
